directAnswer: To connect Bluetooth for lossless audio transmission, ensure both your audio source and receiver support aptX HD or LDAC codecs, then pair them through the Bluetooth settings.
summary: This guide provides steps to connect Bluetooth devices for lossless audio streaming, including platform-specific instructions and common issues.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body: Ensure your audio source (smartphone, computer, etc.) and Bluetooth receiver (headphones, speakers) support lossless audio codecs like aptX HD or LDAC.

sections.heading: Pairing Process
sections.body: Follow the steps below to pair your devices for lossless audio transmission.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.body: If you encounter issues, check codec support and ensure devices are within range.

steps.title: Enable Bluetooth on your source device
steps.detail: Go to the Bluetooth settings on your device and turn on Bluetooth.

steps.title: Put your Bluetooth receiver in pairing mode
steps.detail: Refer to the manufacturer's instructions to activate pairing mode on your headphones or speaker.

steps.title: Select the receiver from the list
steps.detail: In your source device's Bluetooth settings, find and select your Bluetooth receiver from the list of available devices.

steps.title: Verify connection and codec
steps.detail: Once connected, check the audio settings to ensure the device is using aptX HD or LDAC for lossless audio.

faqs.question: What codecs support lossless audio?
faqs.answer: Common codecs for lossless audio include aptX HD, LDAC, and Apple's AAC.

faqs.question: Can I use any Bluetooth headphones for lossless audio?
faqs.answer: No, only headphones that support aptX HD or LDAC will provide lossless audio quality.

faqs.question: What should I do if my devices won't connect?
faqs.answer: Ensure both devices are compatible with lossless codecs and are within Bluetooth range. Restarting both devices can also help.

caveats: Not all Bluetooth devices support lossless audio codecs; check specifications before purchasing.
Audio quality may vary based on distance and interference from other devices.
